import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.optim as optim
from torch.utils.data import DataLoader, TensorDataset
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler, LabelEncoder
from sklearn.metrics import log_loss
import os

# Ensure submission directory exists
os.makedirs("./submission", exist_ok=True)

# Load datasets
train_df = pd.read_csv("./input/train.csv")
test_df = pd.read_csv("./input/test.csv")
sample_sub = pd.read_csv("./input/sample_submission.csv")

# Prepare features and target
feature_cols = [col for col in train_df.columns if col not in ["id", "species"]]
X = train_df[feature_cols].values
y = train_df["species"].values
X_test = test_df[feature_cols].values
test_ids = test_df["id"].values

# Encode labels
le = LabelEncoder()
y_encoded = le.fit_transform(y)
num_classes = len(le.classes_)

# Split data for validation (stratified)
X_train, X_val, y_train, y_val = train_test_split(
    X, y_encoded, test_size=0.2, random_state=42, stratify=y_encoded
)

# Standardize features
scaler = StandardScaler()
X_train = scaler.fit_transform(X_train)
X_val = scaler.transform(X_val)
X_test = scaler.transform(X_test)

# Convert to tensors
X_train_t = torch.FloatTensor(X_train)
y_train_t = torch.LongTensor(y_train)
X_val_t = torch.FloatTensor(X_val)
y_val_t = torch.LongTensor(y_val)
X_test_t = torch.FloatTensor(X_test)


# Define MLP Model
class MLP(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, input_dim, num_classes):
        super(MLP, self).__init__()
        self.layers = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(input_dim, 256),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Dropout(0.3),
            nn.Linear(256, 128),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Dropout(0.3),
            nn.Linear(128, num_classes),
        )

    def forward(self, x):
        return self.layers(x)


# Training function
def train_model(model, train_loader, criterion, optimizer, epochs):
    model.train()
    for epoch in range(epochs):
        for batch_X, batch_y in train_loader:
            optimizer.zero_grad()
            outputs = model(batch_X)
            loss = criterion(outputs, batch_y)
            loss.backward()
            optimizer.step()


# Initialize model and training components
model = MLP(input_dim=X_train.shape[1], num_classes=num_classes)
criterion = nn.CrossEntropyLoss()
optimizer = optim.Adam(model.parameters(), lr=0.001)
train_loader = DataLoader(
    TensorDataset(X_train_t, y_train_t), batch_size=32, shuffle=True
)

# Train on validation split
train_model(model, train_loader, criterion, optimizer, epochs=50)

# Evaluate on validation set
model.eval()
with torch.no_grad():
    val_logits = model(X_val_t)
    val_probs = torch.softmax(val_logits, dim=1).numpy()

val_score = log_loss(y_val, val_probs)
print(f"Validation Multi-class Log Loss: {val_score}")

# Retrain on full training data for submission
X_full_scaled = scaler.fit_transform(X)
y_full_t = torch.LongTensor(y_encoded)
X_full_t = torch.FloatTensor(X_full_scaled)

model_final = MLP(input_dim=X.shape[1], num_classes=num_classes)
optimizer_final = optim.Adam(model_final.parameters(), lr=0.001)
full_loader = DataLoader(TensorDataset(X_full_t, y_full_t), batch_size=32, shuffle=True)

train_model(model_final, full_loader, criterion, optimizer_final, epochs=50)

# Predict on test set
model_final.eval()
with torch.no_grad():
    test_logits = model_final(X_test_t)
    test_probs = torch.softmax(test_logits, dim=1).numpy()

# Prepare submission
submission_df = pd.DataFrame(0.0, index=test_ids, columns=sample_sub.columns)
submission_df["id"] = test_ids

# Map probabilities to species columns
species_to_idx = {sp: i for i, sp in enumerate(le.classes_)}
for sp in le.classes_:
    if sp in sample_sub.columns:
        idx = species_to_idx[sp]
        submission_df[sp] = test_probs[:, idx]

# Save submission
submission_df.to_csv("./submission/submission.csv", index=False)
